junqi-dark-layout v1.0.0

- Initial release with full support for double-sided (25 piece) Chinese Junqi dark layout generation.
- Uses a large model to generate strategic formations with customizable style and focus.
- Python scripts strictly validate all layouts against fixed game rules before user output, ensuring legality (including special positions for forbidden squares, mines, and the flag).
- Successfully validated layouts can be rendered to images using Python.
- Fully documented workflow, recommended output format, and error-handling process included.
